During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]&mdash;the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]&mdash;was '''attacked''' by the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. An [[Unidentified Naboo artist|artist]] who had been experiencing [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] of Naboo's [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], saved her from [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]-fire during the attack.

==Prelude==
Between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] fought each other in the [[The galaxy/Legends|pan-galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> During that [[Time/Legends|time]],<ref name="Legends" /> [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]&mdash;the Republic [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]&mdash;attended a bazaar in the outskirts of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]],<ref name="Artist" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]]. There, her gaze transfixed a reclusive [[Unidentified Naboo artist|artist]], who was overcome with [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] of Amidala and her<ref name="Artist" /> then-[[Reproduction/Legends|unborn]] [[Twin/Legends|twins]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> The [[Artist/Legends|artist]] [[Painting/Legends|painted]] images of Amidala for twenty-four [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] straight, after which he had an epiphany that he needed to save Amidala's life from a Separatist attack.<ref name="Artist" />

==The attack==
The [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] attacked Theed with a [[Confederacy military/Legends|force]] of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droids]] and an [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droid]]. The artist entered Theed and searched the streets for Amidala, finding her just as the Droid Army did, and saved the senator by taking [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire meant for her.<ref name="Artist" />

==Aftermath==
The artist recovered from his injuries and later had visions of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Artist" /> Amidala later [[Death/Legends|died]] in childbirth<ref name="ROTS" /> in 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on Theed appeared in "[[The Artist of Naboo]]," a comic story written and painted by [[Erik Tiemens]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in the [[2005]] anthology ''[[Star Wars: Visionaries]]''.<ref name="Artist" />
